title: How Does A Rainbow Form In The Sky? 🌈
description: A rainbow is not just pretty colors in the sky... it is amazing optical engineering where light bends and splits! Discover the scientific secret.

scenes.say: Ever wonder why a stunning rainbow appears in the sky right after the rain stops and the sun comes out?

scenes.caption: Raindrops act as prisms
scenes.say: Every single raindrop hanging in the air acts like a tiny glass prism that splits white light.
When sunlight enters the water drop, it bends, reflects off the back wall, and bends again as it exits.
The spectrum colors exit at a precise angle of about forty-two degrees relative to the viewer's eye.
Amazingly, a rainbow is actually a complete circle, but we only see half of it because the ground blocks the rest.
